description: This file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakeManager component, focusing on its state management during suspend/resume cycles, error handling during recognition callbacks, and command dispatching based on recognized speech segments.

classes.name: CaptureBox
classes.description: A simple container class used in tests to capture and verify commands dispatched by VoiceWakeManager.

methods.name: suspendAndResumeCycleUpdatesState
methods.description: Tests the suspend and resume cycle of the VoiceWakeManager, checking state changes and status text updates.

methods.name: handleRecognitionCallbackRestartsOnError
methods.description: Verifies that an error during recognition triggers the appropriate status text update and state change.

methods.name: handleRecognitionCallbackDispatchesCommand
methods.description: Ensures that recognized wake words correctly trigger commands and update the status text.
